Low-twist differential-form vanishing on smooth complete intersections via the punctured cone, conormal resolution and Euler contraction; this is a self-contained proof of a known vanishing statement.
Split cubic fourfolds: normal join divisor, reduced Poisson zero scheme, distinct singular scheme, local Pfaffian and modular field, pure ellipticity and generic-rank-four classification.

Smooth positive-dimensional centres: all-order r>=2 lifting at the defining degree d, H^1(I_C^(r-1))=C^{pi_0(C)}/C; the split elliptic double-curve case supplies a nonzero r=3 obstruction, compared specifically with Pym arXiv:1507.05668v1.
Split-fourfold obstruction: 0->I_C^2->I_C^3(3)->i_*J_C^3(3)->0 and the nonzero connecting class delta(g|X) generating H^1(I_C^2)=C.

Published Bricalli-Favale-Pirola Theorem 3.4 with n=5,k=2: ambient rank<=3 Hessian locus containing a plane is equivalent to a (3,3) splitting, and hence by the manuscript normal form to rank-four Poisson existence.

Explicit smooth cubic F=x0^3+x1^3+sum(z_i^3)-(sum z_i)^3: reducible Hessian determinant; constant symmetrizers diag(a,b,cI4); no rank-three idempotent and therefore no (3,3) splitting after any linear coordinate change.
